import sys,csv,math,itertools,re
rna_path,atac_path,gtf_path=sys.argv[1:4]
N=8

def read_matrix(path):
    out={}
    with open(path,newline="") as f:
        rd=csv.reader(f,delimiter="\t")
        hdr=next(rd)
        if len(hdr)!=N+1: raise RuntimeError("RNA column count")
        for row in rd:
            if len(row)<N+1: continue
            try: vals=[float(x) for x in row[1:N+1]]
            except ValueError: continue
            out[row[0]]=vals
    return out

rna=read_matrix(rna_path)
windows={"tss10":{},"tss50":{},"body20":{}}
gene_chr={}
seen=set()
with open(gtf_path) as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line or line[0]=="#": continue
        p=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(p)<9 or p[2]!="gene": continue
        chrom=p[0]
        if chrom not in ["chr"+str(i) for i in range(1,23)]+["chrX","chrY"]: continue
        m=re.search(r'gene_name "([^"]+)"',p[8])
        if not m: continue
        g=m.group(1)
        if g not in rna or g in seen: continue
        seen.add(g)
        start=int(p[3])-1; end=int(p[4]); strand=p[6]
        tss=start if strand=="+" else end-1
        gene_chr[g]=chrom
        defs={"tss10":(max(0,tss-10000),tss+10001),
              "tss50":(max(0,tss-50000),tss+50001),
              "body20":(max(0,start-20000),end+20000)}
        for mode,(a,b) in defs.items():
            mp=windows[mode]
            for k in range(a//10000,(b-1)//10000+1):
                mp.setdefault((chrom,k),[]).append(g)

acts={mode:{g:[0.0]*N for g in gene_chr} for mode in windows}
with open(atac_path,newline="") as f:
    rd=csv.reader(f,delimiter="\t")
    hdr=next(rd)
    if len(hdr)!=N+1: raise RuntimeError("ATAC column count")
    for row in rd:
        if len(row)<N+1: continue
        try:
            chrom,s,e=row[0].rsplit("_",2)
            k=int(s)//10000
            vals=[float(x) for x in row[1:N+1]]
        except (ValueError,IndexError): continue
        key=(chrom,k)
        for mode,mp in windows.items():
            gs=mp.get(key)
            if gs:
                am=acts[mode]
                for g in gs:
                    a=am[g]
                    for j,v in enumerate(vals): a[j]+=v

def centered_unit(v):
    x=[math.log1p(max(0.0,z)) for z in v]
    mu=sum(x)/N
    x=[z-mu for z in x]
    norm=math.sqrt(sum(z*z for z in x))
    if norm<1e-12:return None
    return [z/norm for z in x]

def ranks(v):
    order=sorted(range(N),key=lambda i:v[i])
    out=[0.0]*N
    q=0
    while q<N:
        z=q+1
        while z<N and v[order[z]]==v[order[q]]:z+=1
        av=(q+z-1)/2.0
        for k in range(q,z):out[order[k]]=av
        q=z
    mu=sum(out)/N
    out=[x-mu for x in out]
    norm=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in out))
    if norm<1e-12:return None
    return [x/norm for x in out]

def score(mode,metric,subset):
    S=[[0.0]*N for _ in range(N)]; count=0
    for g,av in acts[mode].items():
        if subset=="A" and sum(ord(c) for c in g)%2: continue
        if subset=="B" and sum(ord(c) for c in g)%2==0: continue
        rv=rna[g]
        zr=centered_unit(rv) if metric=="pearson" else ranks(rv)
        za=centered_unit(av) if metric=="pearson" else ranks(av)
        if zr is None or za is None: continue
        count+=1
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(N): S[i][j]+=zr[i]*za[j]
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N): S[i][j]/=count
    return S,count

def bestperm(S):
    vals=[]
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(N)):
        vals.append((sum(S[i][p[i]] for i in range(N)),p))
    vals.sort(reverse=True)
    return vals[0],vals[1]

rows=[]
for mode in ["tss10","tss50","body20"]:
    for metric in ["pearson","rank"]:
        for subset in ["all","A","B"]:
            S,n=score(mode,metric,subset)
            b,r=bestperm(S)
            margins=[]
            for i in range(N):
                ordered=sorted(S[i],reverse=True)
                margins.append(ordered[0]-ordered[1])
            rows.append((mode,metric,subset,n,b[1],b[0],b[0]-r[0],min(margins),S))
with open("result.txt","w") as out:
    out.write("mode\tmetric\tsubset\tgenes\tpermutation\tobjective\tglobal_gap\tmin_row_gap\n")
    for mode,metric,subset,n,p,obj,gap,mg,S in rows:
        out.write("%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%s\t%.8g\t%.8g\t%.8g\n"%(mode,metric,subset,n,";".join(map(str,p)),obj,gap,mg))
    out.write("\nscore_matrices_all\n")
    for mode,metric,subset,n,p,obj,gap,mg,S in rows:
        if subset!="all":continue
        out.write("%s/%s\n"%(mode,metric))
        for rr in S: out.write("\t".join("%.6f"%x for x in rr)+"\n")
